key_insight: FARMS transforms computational mathematics into AI-ready knowledge linking formal statements, source context, algorithmic meaning and quantitative guarantees.
engineering_relevance: It provides reusable mathematical foundations for trustworthy automation of numerical-method selection, adaptation and development.
method: Prepare source material and build reusable mathematical representations.
Review semantic fidelity to source context and algorithmic meaning.
Use Lean-checked implications from explicit source premises to connect selected statements to computational skills.
evidence_signal: The pipeline accepted 157 of 171 targets in randomized numerical linear algebra and numerical PDEs, with mean estimated costs of US$0.85–2.29 per target across sources and demonstrations in heat-flow solving and wave-response compression.
watch_item: Lean-checked implications cover selected statements under explicit premises; pipeline acceptance alone should not be treated as an end-to-end solver correctness guarantee.
paper_title: FARMS: A Verifiable Foundation for Automated Computational Science
